source: observed lane runs against the capability-gated overlay registry; the gated arm carries the shipped owner contract

method.arm_before: ungated baseline: every registered domain overlay pack is loaded for the task; no context-budgeting contract is in force
method.arm_after: capability-gated: the project declares no optional domain capability, so the gate loads zero overlay packs and only the owner contract the task's domain uses
method.task_identity: the two arms of a task receive identical task text; task_sha256 pins it
method.charge_measure: charged_bytes recomputed from the repository by tests/test_context_budget_contracts.py, never self-reported: the ungated arm is charged the whole overlay registry, the gated arm the whole owner contract it carried (the four sections this unit adds: guard 1457 B + technical-writing 1529 B = 2986 B)
method.work_measure: tool calls per arm, counted by the recorder from each lane transcript's tool-call lines, cross-checked against the lane's self-report
method.shared_framing_excluded: both arms carry the same task text and measurement instructions; those bytes are charged to neither arm
method.failure_note: failed_calls are tool-protocol retries (a stale edit anchor hash) and lane-local counter attempts, not search or read work; they are recorded per arm and excluded from the work categories
not_measured: model latency apart from the lane wall clock
tasks longer than one bounded work unit
method.re_read_note: re_reads and retried_searches are recorded for every arm; the observed value was 0 in both arms of both tasks, so they did not separate the arms on these two runs
method.pack_separator_note: the ungated prompt joins the registry packs with 7 separator newlines; the charge records the recomputed registry prose, which is what actually loads
method.payload_note: as_run_payload_bytes is the literal preamble payload each lane received, as the lane declared it: the ungated arm joins the registry packs with separator newlines, the gated arm carries the owner contract
method.saving_note: Honest restatement: on these two bounded tasks the gated arm saves 17 B of prose per task (3003 -> 2986) and one extra tool call on T1, not thousands of bytes. The gate's value is that a task never loads a pack its project cannot use, and that this contract costs less than the registry it displaces; that is a reduced-or-equal result, not a large one.

tasks.goal: Add the missing rows to the "Required pull-request gate (offline)" list in docs/verification-test-tiers.md so it names every pytest module .github/workflows/portability-offline.yml runs.

acceptance.command:
python - <<'EOF'  (scoped to the 'Required pull-request gate (offline)' section)
import re, pathlib
doc = pathlib.Path('docs/verification-test-tiers.md').read_text()
sec = doc.split('## Required pull-request gate (offline)',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0]
wf = pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/portability-offline.yml').read_text()
wf_mods = sorted(set(re.findall(r'tests/[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.py', wf)))
sec_mods = sorted(set(re.findall(r'tests/[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.py', sec)))
print('EQUAL', int(set(wf_mods) == set(sec_mods)))  # EOF
